issue_request: FHIR-35895 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to update MedicationRequest.performer cardinality from 0..1 to 0..* to support multiple performers.
initial_application: Commit b9257918056a31ebdc080627432cc94db78637e0 changed source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml so MedicationRequest.performer max changed from 1 to *.
additional_context: This issue concerns the same MedicationRequest.performer element as the seed. The current definition also describes multiple performers, including an IV pump and the practitioner who set the pump.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active MedicationRequest StructureDefinition already has MedicationRequest.performer max="*" and explanatory text supporting multiple performers.
